title: Locate Disruption Windows
description: Reads a workload's JobSet/Job Kubernetes events (BackoffLimitExceeded, RestartJobSetFailurePolicyAction, SliceDeleted, suspend/resume) to find every restart and the final teardown, and emits padded, merged time windows. These events are small and cheap to query, so the windows let expensive container-log queries (node resolution, culprit extraction) be confined to where the disruptions happened. Does not replace the full-window crash sweep: a disruption the workload recovered from without a JobSet restart leaves no event here.

start.description: Window start, UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (the full run window).

padding_minutes.description: Minutes added on each side of every restart/backoff/teardown event before overlapping windows are merged.

limit.description: Entry cap per one-day slice; a capped slice sets truncated=true.
